##### Project general facts

The Regent Residences by NSHAMA is a beautifully composed address where every space has been carefully designed to offer a home you can truly call your own. The collection brings together studios, one, two and three bedroom apartments and duplexes, with intuitive contemporary layouts that keep privacy and comfort at their very heart. The facade takes a contemporary approach that ensures warm interiors filled with natural light, finished with warm cladding and textured stucco, while every apartment enjoys great views that connect it with the surrounding landscape.

Residents come home to an airy, welcoming lobby and unwind in a landscaped courtyard that houses a gorgeous swimming pool, a spacious deck and dedicated kids play areas. Premium gyms keep wellness within easy reach, so a wonderful variety of leisure, entertainment and relaxation options is always just a step away. Retail and F&B outlets sit right on the ground floor, adding everyday ease and a lively social note to life at the residences.

Inside, the living and dining areas are filled with abundant natural light, creating spaces that feel open, calm and effortlessly elegant. Bedrooms are finished with glazed porcelain floors and in-built wardrobes, while master bedrooms enjoy the added comfort of their own en-suite bathroom. The modern day kitchen layouts are just as thoughtful, with scratch and stain proof prep counters, generous overhead cabinets and glazed porcelain tile flooring that is as practical as it is handsome.

##### Location description and benefits

Town Square Dubai is a vibrant and expansive mega-development located in the heart of Dubai. At the core of Town Square Dubai is the picturesque Town Square Park, which serves as the central hub for residents and visitors alike. The park features lush green spaces, jogging tracks, and play areas, providing a refreshing escape from the urban hustle and creating a sense of unity and community spirit.

Town Square Dubai boasts a host of exceptional facilities and amenities, making it a vibrant and dynamic place to live. Residents can enjoy access to sports courts, fitness centers, swimming pools, as well as retail and dining outlets within the community. A Town Square Mall, with a variety of shops and entertainment options, further enriches the living experience.

The development's strategic location provides easy connectivity to major highways, ensuring convenient access to other parts of Dubai. Additionally, Town Square Dubai is within proximity to schools, hospitals, and other essential services, offering residents a well-connected and comprehensive lifestyle.
